title: Grateful Dead Live at Shoreline Amphitheatre on 1994-07-01
lineage: Sony TC-D5M (original record deck) > Pre Sonus Inspire GT > Sound Forge > .wav files > Trader's Little Helper > flac files
source: source: 2 Neumann KMF4's > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes;

ai_review.summary: Mixed recording quality with over‑recorded loud spots, but a solid set highlighted by a strong Attics.
ai_review.review: The audience tape from the second tier is uneven – loud passages are over‑recorded and overall clarity isn’t great – yet the performance itself is a standard but solid show. Reviewers especially praised the powerful rendition of “Attics,” calling it a highlight, while noting the venue’s sound was only enjoyable up close.

ai_rating.rationale: One moderate (3‑star) review mentions both positive show aspects and recording flaws; weighting gives a slightly above‑average score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taper recorded from second tier, not optimal spot; over‑recorded in loud spots, overall sound lacks clarity and sounds muddy unless close to the stage.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard, solid performance with good pacing; nothing extraordinary beyond a strong Attics.
